title: 第21章 跨越大境一刀强势斩杀第22章 魔道疗养丹药幽魂碧冥灵丹
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 鬼脸青年走不掉了！
也是到了现在，鬼脸青年才猛然惊醒，原来大言不惭的，是他！
而要把命交代在这里的，也是他！
他望着那寸寸推进、如死神来临的霸道的一刀，望着那巨大沉重的刀背，心头震恐，连反抗的勇气都没有！
屠龙刀给他的感觉太霸道，又沉重又锋利，他感觉就像是命运之刀砍下来，要断了他的命！
而他，毫无招架之力！
而此刻，在美妇眼中。
那把刀落下的很快，却又落下的很慢，时间仿佛在这一刻变慢了无数倍，可以看到刀的残影。
光是残影，便是飓风轰鸣，隆隆作响，真气激荡，风雷之声齐轰！
“咔嚓！”
骤然，一声骨头脆响将她惊醒。
侧目望去。
那一刀终是落在了鬼脸青年头上，重重的砍了下去，只听“咔嚓嚓”
的声音响彻，鬼脸青年头骨爆碎，轰然炸裂，碎骨随着鲜血溅飞。
而那一刀劲力仍在，将他竖着，从头劈开，一直劈到脚，分为两半，而后重重的砍在大地上。
大地被砍出一条十米长的沟壑，朝着前方蔓延百丈。
草木炸裂。
树叶激荡。
鬼脸青年化作两半的脸，望着这一幕，心头大骇，天哪，自己招惹了一个什么怪物？
这是他最后的意识。
下一刻，他重重倒在地上，没了生息。
苏长歌收刀，心念一动，屠龙刀自动消失，被放入系统空间。
随后他负手而立，气定神闲。
恍若刚才斩杀的不是一个半步法相的强者，而是一只小喽啰。
美妇惊呆了。
瞠目结舌。
目瞪口呆。
仿佛看到了鬼。
那不费吹灰之力杀他夫君的鬼脸青年，就这么被杀了？
如此轻松？
一时间，她呆呆的看着苏长歌，嘴巴乱颤，支吾作响，说不出囫囵话。
斩杀了鬼脸青年，苏长歌自然不会错过他身上的好东西。
他并不是盲目的路见不平拔刀相助。
同样也是为了好处而来。
杀了人，搜了身，还为世间荡去了不平，一举两得，美爆了！
旋即，他便开始搜身了。
整个过程中，美妇就这样呆呆的远远看着他，她知道那是苏长歌应得的，并无半分觊觎。
content_en:
The grim-faced young man can’t leave!
It was only now that the grim-faced young man suddenly woke up. It turned out that he was the one who was talking so brazenly!
And it was he who had to hand over his life here!
He looked at the domineering sword that was advancing inch by inch, as if the god of death was coming, and looked at the huge and heavy back of the sword. He was so frightened that he didn't even have the courage to resist!
The dragon-slaying knife felt too overbearing to him, heavy and sharp. He felt like the knife of fate was cutting him off, trying to kill him!
And he was helpless!
But at this moment, in the eyes of the beautiful woman.
The knife fell quickly, but also fell very slowly. Time seemed to slow down countless times at this moment, and the afterimage of the knife could be seen.
Just the afterimage is the roar and rumble of a hurricane, the surging energy, and the sound of wind and thunder!
"Crack!"
Suddenly, a crisp sound of bones woke her up.
Look sideways.
The knife finally fell on the head of the grim-faced young man, slashing hard, and only heard "click"
The sound resounded, and the skull of the grim-faced young man exploded with a bang, and the broken bones flew with blood.
But the force of the knife was still there, standing him upright, splitting him from head to feet, splitting him into two halves, and then slashed hard on the ground.
A ten-meter-long ravine was cut out of the ground, spreading hundreds of feet forward.
The vegetation exploded.
The leaves stir.
The grimace-faced young man's face turned into two halves. Looking at this scene, he was horrified. Oh my god, what kind of monster did he provoke?
This was his last consciousness.
The next moment, he fell heavily to the ground, lifeless.
Su Changge put away the knife, and with a thought, the dragon-slaying knife disappeared automatically and was put into the system space.
Then he stood with his hands behind his back, calm and relaxed.
It seemed as if what he had just killed was not a strong man with half-step skills, but a little minion.
The beautiful woman was stunned.
Jaw-dropping.
stunned.
It was like seeing a ghost.
The grim-faced young man who had effortlessly killed his husband was killed just like that?
So easy?
For a moment, she stared at Su Changge blankly, her mouth trembling and hesitating, unable to speak straight words.
After killing the grim-faced young man, Su Changge would naturally not miss the good things in him.
He did not blindly draw out his sword to help when there was injustice.
It’s also for the benefit.
He killed someone, searched his body, and brought injustice to the world. He killed two birds with one stone. It was so beautiful!
Immediately, he began to search him.
During the whole process, the beautiful woman just stared at him from a distance blankly. She knew that Su Changge deserved it and she didn't covet him in the slightest.
